Provide network boot services to devices.zh-CN: 为局域网设备提供网络启动服务。
Provide network boot services to devices.en: Provide network boot services to devices on the local network.

If the firmware opens a shell, return to.zh-CN: 若固件打开了 Shell，请返回启动菜单并选择网络启动项。
If the firmware opens a shell, return to.en: If the firmware opens a shell, return to its boot menu and select the network boot option.

Board-specific DTB, load addresses and t.zh-CN: 板级 DTB、加载地址及 `fdt_addr` 变量必须与设备匹配；仅当固件提供 `${fdtcontroladdr}` 时，才能执行 `setenv fdt_addr ${fdtcontroladdr}`。
Board-specific DTB, load addresses and t.en: Board-specific DTB, load addresses and the `fdt_addr` variable must match the device; `setenv fdt_addr ${fdtcontroladdr}` is only valid where the firmware provides it.

Kernel parameters are assigned to U-Boot.zh-CN: 执行 `booti`/`bootm` 前，将内核参数写入 U-Boot 的 `bootargs`。
Kernel parameters are assigned to U-Boot.en: Kernel parameters are assigned to U-Boot `bootargs` before `booti`/`bootm`.

Debian RISC-V netboot `linux` is a PE/EF.zh-CN: Debian RISC-V 网络启动文件 `linux` 是 PE/EFI 镜像。请使用 `booti`；原始 initrd 需要指定下载大小（`${filesize}`）。`bootefi` 不接受 initrd 参数。加载地址必须与开发板匹配。
Debian RISC-V netboot `linux` is a PE/EF.en: Debian RISC-V netboot `linux` is a PE/EFI image. Use `booti`; raw initrds require the downloaded size (`${filesize}`). `bootefi` has no initrd argument. Load addresses must match the board.

Replace <net-device> with the firmware-s.zh-CN: 把 <net-device> 替换为 show device 列出的固件支持的以太网设备（如 ewa0、ewb0 或 era0），并按该机型手册核对控制台语法。小型引导器分别下载 Debian 内核和 initrd。
Replace <net-device> with the firmware-s.en: Replace <net-device> with the firmware-supported Ethernet device from show device (for example ewa0, ewb0 or era0). Check the machine manual for console-specific syntax. The small loader downloads the Debian kernel and initrd separately.

SRM first needs static firmware network.zh-CN: SRM 首先需要静态固件网络设置或 BOOTP 来加载小引导器；之后引导器支持普通 DHCP 加 Bootah ProxyDHCP。
SRM first needs static firmware network.en: SRM first needs static firmware network settings or BOOTP to load the small loader. The loader then supports ordinary DHCP plus Bootah ProxyDHCP.

Each target platform requires separate v.zh-CN: 目标平台必须单独验证；ES40 的验收结果不代表其他 Alpha 平台已通过。
Each target platform requires separate v.en: Each target platform requires separate validation; ES40 results do not certify other Alpha systems.

At the SRM `>>>` prompt; run `show devic.zh-CN: 在 SRM 的 `>>>` 提示符下执行；若以太网设备不是 `ewa0`，请用 `show device` 查询设备名。
At the SRM `>>>` prompt; run `show devic.en: At the SRM `>>>` prompt; run `show device` if the Ethernet device is not `ewa0`.

A complete OpenVMS network installation.zh-CN: 完整的 OpenVMS 网络安装需要 InfoServer LAD/LAST 介质服务。
A complete OpenVMS network installation.en: A complete OpenVMS network installation requires an InfoServer LAD/LAST media service.

MOP loads the second-stage bootstrap bef.zh-CN: MOP 加载第二阶段引导程序后进入 Linux 内核。
MOP loads the second-stage bootstrap bef.en: MOP loads the second-stage bootstrap before entering the Linux kernel.

SRM obtains the boot file name from BOOT.zh-CN: SRM 从 BOOTP/DHCP 获取启动文件名，Bootah 通过 TFTP 提供文件。
SRM obtains the boot file name from BOOT.en: SRM obtains the boot file name from BOOTP/DHCP; Bootah serves the file over TFTP.

The profile kernel arguments are passed.zh-CN: 镜像内核参数通过 SRM 的 `-flags` 传递；若控制台拒绝这些参数，请移除。
The profile kernel arguments are passed.en: The profile kernel arguments are passed as SRM `-flags`; remove them if the console rejects them.

Bootah does not provide the NFS root use.zh-CN: Bootah 不提供 NetBSD/OpenBSD 无盘启动所需的 NFS 根文件系统。
Bootah does not provide the NFS root use.en: Bootah does not provide the NFS root used by NetBSD/OpenBSD diskless boot.

At the SGI PROM `>>` prompt. If `bootp().zh-CN: 在 SGI PROM 的 `>>` 提示符下执行。若不接受 `bootp():`，请使用 `boot -f bootp()/netboot-boot.img`。
At the SGI PROM `>>` prompt. If `bootp().en: At the SGI PROM `>>` prompt. If `bootp():` is rejected, use `boot -f bootp()/netboot-boot.img`.

OpenBoot loads original ofwboot.net thro.zh-CN: 原厂 OpenBoot 通过 RARP/TFTP 加载原版 ofwboot.net，再经 bootparams/NFS 加载 bsd.rd。请开启以太网协议、绑定静态 IP 和镜像；真机启动待验收。
OpenBoot loads original ofwboot.net thro.en: OpenBoot loads original ofwboot.net through RARP/TFTP, then bsd.rd through bootparams/NFS. Enable Ethernet protocols and assign a static IP and image. Hardware boot validation is pending.

OpenBoot loads Bootah through RARP/TFTP;.zh-CN: 原厂 OpenBoot 通过 RARP/TFTP 加载 Bootah 二阶段，再以 DHCP/ProxyDHCP 获取 GRUB 或原版 BSD 引导器及内核参数。请分配镜像并开启以太网协议与 DHCP 或 ProxyDHCP；已设置 IP 优先，否则自动申请 RARP 地址。真机验收待完成。
OpenBoot loads Bootah through RARP/TFTP;.en: OpenBoot loads Bootah through RARP/TFTP; DHCP/ProxyDHCP then selects GRUB or the original BSD loader and kernel arguments. Assign an image and enable Ethernet protocols and DHCP or ProxyDHCP. A configured IP takes priority; otherwise Bootah obtains a RARP address automatically. Hardware validation is pending.

OpenBoot uses RARP with `boot net`; `boo.zh-CN: OpenBoot 的 `boot net` 使用 RARP；`boot net:dhcp` 要求固件通过 DHCP 配置客户端。
OpenBoot uses RARP with `boot net`; `boo.en: OpenBoot uses RARP with `boot net`; `boot net:dhcp` asks the firmware to configure the client with DHCP.

OpenBoot uses RARP by default; enable DH.zh-CN: OpenBoot 默认使用 RARP；如需 DHCP，请在 Bootah 中启用 DHCP，然后使用 `boot net:dhcp`。
OpenBoot uses RARP by default; enable DH.en: OpenBoot uses RARP by default; enable DHCP in Bootah and use `boot net:dhcp` to use DHCP instead.

Assign this profile before booting. BOOT.zh-CN: 启动前请为设备分配此镜像。BOOTP/DHCP 提供文件名；RARP 仅提供 IP 地址，OpenBoot 据此生成 TFTP 文件名。
Assign this profile before booting. BOOT.en: Assign this profile before booting. BOOTP/DHCP supplies a filename; RARP supplies an IP address, from which OpenBoot derives its TFTP filename.

IA64 ELILO netboot is started from the E.zh-CN: IA64 ELILO 网络启动从 EFI 固件的网络启动项发起：固件通过 PXE/DHCP 加载 `elilo.efi`，然后 ELILO 从同一 TFTP 目录读取 `elilo-ia64.conf`、内核和 initrd。
IA64 ELILO netboot is started from the E.en: IA64 ELILO netboot is started from the EFI firmware network boot option: firmware PXE/DHCP loads `elilo.efi`, then ELILO reads `elilo-ia64.conf`, the kernel and initrd from the same TFTP directory.

An EFI shell can configure the network w.zh-CN: EFI Shell 可用 `ifconfig -s eth0 dhcp` 配置网络，但标准 EFI Shell 没有发起 PXE/ELILO 网络启动的命令。
An EFI shell can configure the network w.en: An EFI shell can configure the network with `ifconfig -s eth0 dhcp`, but the standard EFI shell has no command that starts a PXE/ELILO network boot.

This profile already prepares `elilo.efi.zh-CN: 此镜像已为 TFTP 准备 `elilo.efi` 和 `elilo-ia64.conf`。
This profile already prepares `elilo.efi.en: This profile already prepares `elilo.efi` and `elilo-ia64.conf` for TFTP.

At the PDC `BOOT_ADMIN>` prompt, `boot l.zh-CN: 在 PDC 的 `BOOT_ADMIN>` 提示符下执行 `boot lan`，通过 BOOTP/TFTP 启动；DHCP/BOOTP 应答提供启动文件名。
At the PDC `BOOT_ADMIN>` prompt, `boot l.en: At the PDC `BOOT_ADMIN>` prompt, `boot lan` asks the firmware to use BOOTP/TFTP; the boot file name is supplied by the DHCP/BOOTP reply.

Newer Series 700 and B/C/J class systems.zh-CN: 较新的 Series 700 和 B/C/J 系列使用 BOOTP/TFTP；仅支持 RMP 的旧型号使用 RMP。
Newer Series 700 and B/C/J class systems.en: Newer Series 700 and B/C/J class systems use BOOTP/TFTP; older RMP-only models use RMP instead.

Make sure the firmware boot file matches.zh-CN: 请确认固件启动文件名与此镜像的 `default` 启动文件映射一致。
Make sure the firmware boot file matches.en: Make sure the firmware boot file matches the `default` boot file mapping of this profile.

OpenBSD SPARC64: Bootah OBP loads origin.zh-CN: OpenBSD SPARC64：Bootah 二阶段加载原版 ofwboot.net 和 bsd.rd。执行 boot net；开启以太网协议及 DHCP 或 ProxyDHCP，并分配镜像。优先使用设置的 IP，否则为 RARP 自动申请 DHCP 地址。真机启动仍待验证。
OpenBSD SPARC64: Bootah OBP loads origin.en: OpenBSD SPARC64: Bootah OBP loads original ofwboot.net and bsd.rd. Use boot net; enable Ethernet protocols and DHCP or ProxyDHCP, and assign an image. A configured IP takes priority; otherwise Bootah obtains a DHCP lease for RARP. Hardware boot validation is pending.

Requesting a DHCP lease for RARP client.zh-CN: 正在为 RARP 客户端申请 DHCP 租约
Requesting a DHCP lease for RARP client.en: Requesting a DHCP lease for RARP client

DHCP rejected the RARP lease; retry late.zh-CN: DHCP 拒绝了 RARP 租约，将稍后重试
DHCP rejected the RARP lease; retry late.en: DHCP rejected the RARP lease; retry later

RARP DHCP lease expired; no address will.zh-CN: RARP 的 DHCP 租约已到期，停止返回该地址
RARP DHCP lease expired; no address will.en: RARP DHCP lease expired; no address will be returned

DHCP lease request timed out; no RARP ad.zh-CN: DHCP 租约申请超时，未返回 RARP 地址
DHCP lease request timed out; no RARP ad.en: DHCP lease request timed out; no RARP address returned

OpenBSD SPARC64: release-matched ofwboot.zh-CN: OpenBSD SPARC64：缺少同版本的 ofwboot.net；请使用包含 base 安装集的介质。
OpenBSD SPARC64: release-matched ofwboot.en: OpenBSD SPARC64: release-matched ofwboot.net is missing; use installation media containing the base set.

Invalid OpenBSD SPARC64 network loader.zh-CN: OpenBSD SPARC64 网络引导器格式无效

OpenBSD SPARC64 installation notes are m.zh-CN: 缺少 OpenBSD SPARC64 安装说明
OpenBSD SPARC64 installation notes are m.en: OpenBSD SPARC64 installation notes are missing

OpenBSD installation media was recognize.zh-CN: 已识别为 OpenBSD 安装介质，但导入器尚不支持其架构。
OpenBSD installation media was recognize.en: OpenBSD installation media was recognized, but its architecture is not supported by this importer.

no supported installation ramdisk and ne.zh-CN: 未找到受支持的安装内存盘和网络引导器
no supported installation ramdisk and ne.en: no supported installation ramdisk and network loader were found

NetBSD/sparc is a 32-bit installation im.zh-CN: 这是 32 位 NetBSD/sparc 安装镜像，并非 SPARC64。Bootah 暂未支持此端口；SPARC64 机器请使用 NetBSD/sparc64 镜像。
NetBSD/sparc is a 32-bit installation im.en: NetBSD/sparc is a 32-bit installation image, not SPARC64. This port is not supported by Bootah yet; use NetBSD/sparc64 media for a SPARC64 machine.

Debian Alpha: small SRM loader with sepa.zh-CN: Debian Alpha：小型 SRM 引导器分别加载原版内核与 initrd；平台验收见 docs/alpha-srm.md
Debian Alpha: small SRM loader with sepa.en: Debian Alpha: small SRM loader with separate original kernel/initrd; platform validation recorded in docs/alpha-srm.md

SRM loader compatibility must be verifie.zh-CN: SRM 引导器需在目标固件单独验证；ES40 的结果不代表其他平台已通过
SRM loader compatibility must be verifie.en: SRM loader compatibility must be verified for the target firmware; ES40 evidence does not certify other platforms

Secure Boot allows editing the name and.zh-CN: 安全启动仅允许修改名称和启动参数
Secure Boot allows editing the name and.en: Secure Boot allows editing the name and boot parameters only

Select a Windows OS loader using entry={.zh-CN: 请使用 entry={GUID} 指定 Windows 系统启动项
Select a Windows OS loader using entry={.en: Select a Windows OS loader using entry={GUID}

OpenBSD EFI loader exceeds cache budget.en: OpenBSD EFI loader exceeds cache budget

OpenBSD EFI loader architecture mismatch.zh-CN: OpenBSD EFI 引导器架构不匹配

This boot medium has no local distributi.zh-CN: 此启动介质未包含本地安装集，请在 bsdinstall 中选择匹配的 FreeBSD 镜像站。
This boot medium has no local distributi.en: This boot medium has no local distribution sets; select a matching FreeBSD mirror in bsdinstall.

OpenBSD original installation ramdisk. I.zh-CN: 使用 OpenBSD 原版安装内存盘。未包含安装集，请在安装器中选择匹配的外部镜像站。
OpenBSD original installation ramdisk. I.en: OpenBSD original installation ramdisk. Installation sets are absent; select a matching external mirror in the installer.

OpenBSD ISO lacks installation sets; an.zh-CN: OpenBSD 光盘缺少安装集，需要匹配发行版本的外部安装源。
OpenBSD ISO lacks installation sets; an.en: OpenBSD ISO lacks installation sets; an external matching release is required.

Installation sets are absent; an externa.zh-CN: 未包含安装集，需要匹配发行版本的外部安装源。
Installation sets are absent; an externa.en: Installation sets are absent; an external matching release is required.

FreeBSD native network loader: original.zh-CN: FreeBSD 原生网络引导器通过只读 NFS 加载原版内核，并将原始 ISO 作为内存光盘。需要 NFS/portmapper 服务及足够内存容纳整个 ISO。安装过程需要手动操作。
FreeBSD native network loader: original.en: FreeBSD native network loader: original kernel and ISO memory disk over read-only NFS. Requires NFS/portmapper and enough client memory for the entire ISO. Installation remains interactive.

FreeBSD ISO lacks a matching native netw.zh-CN: FreeBSD 光盘缺少匹配的原生网络引导器
FreeBSD ISO lacks a matching native netw.en: FreeBSD ISO lacks a matching native network loader

OpenBSD original installation ramdisk. S.zh-CN: 使用 OpenBSD 原版安装内存盘。请在安装器中选择光盘的 HTTP 文件目录获取安装集；目标磁盘仍由用户选择。
OpenBSD original installation ramdisk. S.en: OpenBSD original installation ramdisk. Select the ISO HTTP file tree for installation sets; disk selection remains interactive.

ISO lacks the release-matched PXE loader.zh-CN: 光盘缺少与该发行版本匹配的 PXE 引导器，无法使用 BIOS 网络启动
ISO lacks the release-matched PXE loader.en: ISO lacks the release-matched PXE loader; BIOS network boot is unavailable

OpenBSD ISO lacks a matching network loa.zh-CN: OpenBSD 光盘缺少匹配的网络引导器
OpenBSD ISO lacks a matching network loa.en: OpenBSD ISO lacks a matching network loader

ISO lacks a matching network loader.zh-CN: 光盘缺少匹配的网络引导器
ISO lacks a matching network loader.en: ISO lacks a matching network loader

no supported INSTALL ramdisk in image; G.zh-CN: 镜像中没有受支持的 INSTALL 安装内存盘；普通 GENERIC 内核不能充当安装器
no supported INSTALL ramdisk in image; G.en: no supported INSTALL ramdisk in image; GENERIC is not an installer

Select the ISO HTTP tree.zh-CN: 请在安装器中选择光盘的 HTTP 文件目录

in sysinst; disk selection remains inter.zh-CN: 获取安装集；目标磁盘仍由用户选择。
in sysinst; disk selection remains inter.en: in sysinst; disk selection remains interactive.

Select the network device in SLOF, or th.zh-CN: 请在 SLOF 中选择网络设备，或在 Petitboot 中选择发现的网络安装项。此镜像的启动文件列出了可用的固件类型。
Select the network device in SLOF, or th.en: Select the network device in SLOF, or the discovered network installation entry in Petitboot. Available firmware types are listed in this image's boot files.

Manual Open Firmware commands depend on.zh-CN: Open Firmware 手动命令取决于固件提供的设备别名；不同固件类型的启动方式不能混用。
Manual Open Firmware commands depend on.en: Manual Open Firmware commands depend on the device aliases provided by the firmware. Firmware types are not interchangeable.

SLOF/Open Firmware requires grub-powerpc.zh-CN: SLOF/Open Firmware 需要 grub-powerpc.elf；请使用 GRUB 2.14 或更新版本运行 tools/power-boot/build.sh。
SLOF/Open Firmware requires grub-powerpc.en: SLOF/Open Firmware requires grub-powerpc.elf; run tools/power-boot/build.sh with GRUB >= 2.14.

FreeBSD PowerPC64 LE on PowerNV/Petitboo.zh-CN: FreeBSD PowerPC64 LE 仅支持 PowerNV/Petitboot：使用原版内核，并通过内核的 MD_ROOT_MEM/Open Firmware 接口将原始 ISO 作为初始内存盘加载。客户机需要足够内存容纳 ISO。安装过程需要手动操作。
FreeBSD PowerPC64 LE on PowerNV/Petitboo.en: FreeBSD PowerPC64 LE on PowerNV/Petitboot only: original kernel and original ISO as initrd, using the kernel MD_ROOT_MEM/Open Firmware initrd ABI. Requires guest memory for the ISO. Installation remains interactive.

Explicit workaround for the firmware kex.zh-CN: 此选项用于规避 FreeBSD 官方记录的固件 kexec-lite 入口地址问题；派生内核仅修改 ELF e_entry 字段。已修复的固件应使用标准配置。本配置不会被自动选择，尚未完成启动验证。
Explicit workaround for the firmware kex.en: Explicit workaround for the firmware kexec-lite entry-point regression documented by FreeBSD: only the derived ELF e_entry differs from the ISO kernel. Use the standard profile on fixed firmware; this profile is not selected automatically. Runtime validation of this alternate profile is pending.

PowerNV only. Choose the legacy kexec-li.zh-CN: 仅支持 PowerNV。只有遇到 FreeBSD 官方记录的固件问题时，才应选择旧版 kexec-lite 配置；不提供 pSeries/SLOF 启动方式。
PowerNV only. Choose the legacy kexec-li.en: PowerNV only. Choose the legacy kexec-lite profile only for the firmware regression documented by FreeBSD; pSeries/SLOF is not offered.

PowerNV only. This kernel's ELF layout d.zh-CN: 仅支持 PowerNV。此内核的 ELF 布局不适用旧版 kexec-lite 兼容处理，仅提供标准配置。
PowerNV only. This kernel's ELF layout d.en: PowerNV only. This kernel's ELF layout does not support the legacy kexec-lite workaround; only the standard profile is available.

OpenBSD powerpc64: original bsd.rd for P.zh-CN: OpenBSD powerpc64：使用原版 bsd.rd，仅支持 PowerNV/Petitboot。此 OpenBSD 移植不支持 PowerVM/pSeries。适配依据官方文档，尚未完成启动验证。
OpenBSD powerpc64: original bsd.rd for P.en: OpenBSD powerpc64: original bsd.rd for PowerNV/Petitboot only. PowerVM/pSeries is not supported by this OpenBSD port. Documentation-based adaptation; not boot-tested.

OpenBSD powerpc64 adaptation follows off.zh-CN: OpenBSD powerpc64 适配依据官方文档，尚待启动验收。
OpenBSD powerpc64 adaptation follows off.en: OpenBSD powerpc64 adaptation follows official documentation; runtime acceptance pending.

Secure Boot mode unavailable for this im.en: Secure Boot mode unavailable for this image

Network access is required. Recheck to r.en: Network access is required. Recheck to request authorization.

Install ChmodBPF from https://www.wiresh.en: Install ChmodBPF from https://www.wireshark.org/download.html and restart Bootah.

Enable the Bootah network helper in macO.en: Enable the Bootah network helper in macOS System Settings, or install ChmodBPF from https://www.wireshark.org/download.html .

Check failed. Check the core connection.en: Check failed. Check the core connection and retry.

The configured network services require.zh-CN: 当前网络服务配置需要 Root 权限。请在 Bootah 设置中结束本机服务，选择“Root 启动”，并在 Root 管理器中允许授权。设备不支持 Root 时，请使用桌面主机提供标准网络启动服务。
The configured network services require.en: The configured network services require Root access. In Bootah settings, stop the local core, choose Root startup, and approve access in your Root manager. If this device does not provide Root, use a desktop host for standard network boot services.

Open Network permissions in Bootah and e.zh-CN: 请打开 Bootah 的“网络权限”，在 macOS 系统设置中启用内置网络助手。也可从 Wireshark 官方 macOS 安装镜像安装 ChmodBPF 后重试：https://www.wireshark.org/download.html 。
Open Network permissions in Bootah and e.en: Open Network permissions in Bootah and enable its bundled network helper in macOS System Settings. Alternatively, install ChmodBPF from the official Wireshark macOS disk image: https://www.wireshark.org/download.html . Then retry.

Network capture requires BPF access. Ins.zh-CN: 网络抓包需要 BPF 访问权限。请从 Wireshark 官方 macOS 安装镜像安装 ChmodBPF，然后重新启动 Bootah：https://www.wireshark.org/download.html 。
Network capture requires BPF access. Ins.en: Network capture requires BPF access. Install ChmodBPF from the official Wireshark macOS disk image: https://www.wireshark.org/download.html . Then restart Bootah.

The system libpcap library could not be.zh-CN: 无法加载系统 libpcap 组件。请修复系统组件后重新启动 Bootah。
The system libpcap library could not be.en: The system libpcap library could not be loaded. Restore the system library and restart Bootah.

Install Npcap from https://npcap.com/#do.zh-CN: 请从 https://npcap.com/#download 下载并安装 Npcap，启用 WinPcap API 兼容模式，然后重新启动 Bootah。
Install Npcap from https://npcap.com/#do.en: Install Npcap from https://npcap.com/#download with WinPcap API-compatible mode enabled, then restart Bootah.

Allow the Npcap authorization prompt. If.zh-CN: 请允许 Npcap 的授权请求；若仍被拒绝，请使用“以管理员身份运行”重新启动 Bootah。
Allow the Npcap authorization prompt. If.en: Allow the Npcap authorization prompt. If access is still denied, restart Bootah using Run as administrator.

Grant packet capture access by installin.zh-CN: 请从 Wireshark 官方 macOS 安装镜像安装 ChmodBPF，以授予网络抓包权限：https://www.wireshark.org/download.html 。安装后重新启动 Bootah。“授权检测”仅授权临时 DHCP 探测进程。
Grant packet capture access by installin.en: Grant packet capture access by installing ChmodBPF from the official Wireshark macOS disk image: https://www.wireshark.org/download.html . Restart Bootah after installation. Authorize detection only grants access to a temporary DHCP probe.

Install the Bootah network helper using.zh-CN: 请在 Bootah 发行包目录中运行 sudo sh scripts/install_linux_core.sh /path/to/netboot-core 安装网络权限辅助组件，并将路径替换为实际核心程序路径。
Install the Bootah network helper using.en: Install the Bootah network helper using sudo sh scripts/install_linux_core.sh /path/to/netboot-core from the Bootah distribution.

Install polkit (pkexec) and a desktop au.en: Install polkit (pkexec) and a desktop authentication agent using your distribution package manager, then retry and approve the authorization prompt. For TUI, install sudo and use --authorization sudo.

Network access was not authorized. Retry.en: Network access was not authorized. Retry and approve the system authorization prompt; on Linux ensure a desktop polkit authentication agent is running.

Permission to bind this network port was.zh-CN: 无法绑定网络端口。请在服务所在主机上授予 Bootah 核心网络访问权限后重试。Windows 请检查管理员权限及安全软件限制；macOS 请联系管理员为核心授予所需的服务权限。
Permission to bind this network port was.en: Permission to bind this network port was denied. Grant network access to the Bootah core on the service host and retry. On Windows, check administrator and security software restrictions; on macOS, ask an administrator to grant the core the required service permissions.

Starting services requests macOS adminis.zh-CN: 启动服务时会请求 macOS 管理员授权。仅临时网络进程以管理员权限运行，退出应用后结束。
Starting services requests macOS adminis.en: Starting services requests macOS administrator approval. Only the temporary network process runs with elevated privileges and exits when the app closes.

Allow the network helper in System Setti.zh-CN: 请在系统设置中允许网络助手后，再点击启动。
Allow the network helper in System Setti.en: Allow the network helper in System Settings, then click Start again.

Could not enable the network helper. Che.zh-CN: 无法启用网络助手。请检查系统设置中的后台项目许可。
Could not enable the network helper. Che.en: Could not enable the network helper. Check background item approval in System Settings.

Allow the Bootah network helper in Syste.zh-CN: 在系统设置中允许 Bootah 网络助手后，即可启动服务。
Allow the Bootah network helper in Syste.en: Allow the Bootah network helper in System Settings to start services.

Notifications are disabled. Allow Bootah.zh-CN: 通知权限未开启。请在应用设置中允许 Bootah 发送通知，以显示后台服务状态。
Notifications are disabled. Allow Bootah.en: Notifications are disabled. Allow Bootah notifications in app settings to see background service status.

1. Open the official Wireshark download.zh-CN: 1. 打开 Wireshark 官方下载页，下载 macOS 安装镜像。
1. Open the official Wireshark download.en: 1. Open the official Wireshark download page and download the macOS disk image.

2. Open Install ChmodBPF.pkg in the disk.zh-CN: 2. 打开镜像中的 Install ChmodBPF.pkg，按安装器指引授予权限。
2. Open Install ChmodBPF.pkg in the disk.en: 2. Open Install ChmodBPF.pkg in the disk image and follow the installer to grant access.

3. Restart Bootah, then detect the netwo.zh-CN: 3. 完成后重新启动 Bootah，再重新检测或启动服务。
3. Restart Bootah, then detect the netwo.en: 3. Restart Bootah, then detect the network again or start services.

When using an external core, configure n.zh-CN: 连接外部核心时，请在服务所在主机上配置网络权限。
When using an external core, configure n.en: When using an external core, configure network permissions on the service host.

Use x64-efi=bootx64.efi, one mapping per.zh-CN: 请按 x64-efi=bootx64.efi 的格式填写，每行一项
Use x64-efi=bootx64.efi, one mapping per.en: Use x64-efi=bootx64.efi, one mapping per line

Complete the boot configuration using th.zh-CN: 请先完成启动配置，详见下方说明
Complete the boot configuration using th.en: Complete the boot configuration using the notes below

Use the network boot option in the firmw.zh-CN: 请使用固件的网络启动入口
Use the network boot option in the firmw.en: Use the network boot option in the firmware

Select network boot in the firmware menu.zh-CN: 从固件菜单选择网络启动，无需输入命令
Select network boot in the firmware menu.en: Select network boot in the firmware menu; no command is needed

Run these commands in the firmware.zh-CN: 在固件中执行以下命令
Run these commands in the firmware.en: Run these commands in the firmware

Loading automatic configuration options….zh-CN: 正在读取自动配置选项…

This platform does not support automatic.zh-CN: 该平台不支持自动配置
This platform does not support automatic.en: This platform does not support automatic configuration

Select a device or image first.en: Select a device or image first

Raw logs contain private data.zh-CN: 原始日志包含隐私信息

Raw logs may contain device addresses an.zh-CN: 原始日志可能包含设备地址和本地文件路径。
Raw logs may contain device addresses an.en: Raw logs may contain device addresses and local file paths.

Trust selected local ISO source.zh-CN: 信任所选本地 ISO 安装源

ISO import requires a local service.zh-CN: ISO 导入需连接本机服务
ISO import requires a local service.en: ISO import requires a local service

Address allocation and ProxyDHCP cannot.zh-CN: 分配地址与 ProxyDHCP 不能同时开启
Address allocation and ProxyDHCP cannot.en: Address allocation and ProxyDHCP cannot both be enabled

Enter a MAC or IP address.zh-CN: 至少填写 MAC 或 IP
Enter a MAC or IP address.en: Enter a MAC or IP address

Automatic mode selects proxy from detect.zh-CN: 启用自动模式后按检测结果选择代理；不会自动启动服务
Automatic mode selects proxy from detect.en: Automatic mode selects proxy from detection results; services are not started automatically

ProxyDHCP (external DHCP assigns address.zh-CN: ProxyDHCP（外部 DHCP 分配地址）

Import outcome is uncertain; ISO retaine.zh-CN: 未能确认导入结果，已保留 ISO 以免破坏启动引用。
Import outcome is uncertain; ISO retaine.en: Import outcome is uncertain; ISO retained to preserve boot references.

Select the NIC's PXE/IPv4 boot entry in.zh-CN: 在固件启动菜单中选择网卡的 PXE/IPv4 启动项；Bootah 将提供 `{file}` 作为网络启动文件，无需输入命令。
Select the NIC's PXE/IPv4 boot entry in.en: Select the NIC's PXE/IPv4 boot entry in the firmware boot menu; Bootah returns `{file}` as the network boot file. No command needs to be typed.

The firmware must support `tftpdstp` for.zh-CN: 使用非标准 TFTP 端口 {port} 时，固件必须支持 `tftpdstp`。
The firmware must support `tftpdstp` for.en: The firmware must support `tftpdstp` for the non-standard TFTP port {port}.
